sec: sec:E017: Document system transparency policy / Control mays

blocks.id: blk:E017: Document system transparency policy / Control mays/1
blocks.text: Defining policies for sharing transparency documentation with external stakeholders. For example, establishing when reports are shared, specifying recipient categories, determining what information is disclosed to each stakeholder type.

sentences.text: Defining policies for sharing transparency documentation with external stakeholders.
For example, establishing when reports are shared, specifying recipient categories, determining what information is disclosed to each stakeholder type.

blocks.id: blk:E017: Document system transparency policy / Control mays/2
blocks.text: Documenting sharing procedures including approval workflows, version control, and distribution tracking. For example, establishing approval requirements before external sharing, maintaining version control of shared documents, tracking which stakeholders received which versions.

sentences.text: Documenting sharing procedures including approval workflows, version control, and distribution tracking.

blocks.id: blk:E017: Document system transparency policy / Control mays/3
blocks.text: Documenting platform-level and deployer-level security responsibilities for AI systems. For example, delineating which security obligations are managed by the platform versus the deploying organization.
